profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain simulation software for the F-35 virtual cockpit. Participate in all stages of the software life cycle from design to testing and sustainment though agile methodologies. Programmed mainly in C++, with emphasis on Object Oriented Programming.

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description: Lead groups of prospective students and their families on tours of the University of Arkansas Campus as part of University Admissions recruitment process.

positions.title: CSCE Technical Support
positions.description: Technical support for the Computer Science and Computer Engineering Department of the College of Engineering. Helped administer computer software and hardware for 5 student labs as well as professors' research labs. Designed webpages for the department including an online scholarship application and student surveys.

positions.title: Freshman Engineering Peer Mentor
positions.description: Helped guide freshman engineering students in the transition from High School to college life through discussions on topics such as school-life balance, budgeting, major selection, and homework and study habits.

positions.title: Grader for Linear Algebra
positions.description: Created keys, proctored tests and graded assignments for multiple classes of Linear Algebra students.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Fort Worth Animal Care and Control
volunteerExperiences.description: I Walk and socialize dogs to help them get used to people, and learn their personalities to help match perspective pet parents with their newest family member. Adopt, don't shop!

company.name: Fort Worth Animal Care and Control
